microSkill: find the perimeter of a rectangle from its length and width
objectiveWording: Find the perimeter of a rectangle from its labelled length and width, giving the answer as an exact length in the stated unit.
successCriteria: Reads the length and width from the labelled figure.
Adds all four side lengths (or applies 2 × (length + width)).
States the exact perimeter with the correct length unit.

subtopic: perimeter of a composite rectilinear shape
microSkill: find the perimeter of a composite rectilinear shape (including L-shapes) by tracing the exterior boundary
objectiveWording: Find the perimeter of a composite rectilinear shape (including L-shapes) by adding the lengths of its complete exterior boundary, giving the answer as an exact length in the stated unit.
successCriteria: Identifies the complete exterior boundary of the shape.
Finds any unlabelled exterior edge from the given lengths.
Adds every exterior edge exactly once (no internal lines) and states the exact perimeter with its unit.

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School mensuration (perimeter of composite rectilinear shapes)

microSkill: find the area of a rectangle from its length and width
objectiveWording: Find the area of a rectangle from its labelled length and width, giving the answer as an exact area in square units of the stated unit.
successCriteria: Reads the length and width from the labelled figure.
Multiplies length by width.
States the exact area in square units of the stated unit.

subtopic: area of a triangle from base and perpendicular height
microSkill: find the area of a triangle from a shown base and perpendicular height
objectiveWording: Find the area of a triangle from its base and an explicitly shown perpendicular height, giving the answer as an exact area in square units of the stated unit.
successCriteria: Identifies the base and the perpendicular height marked on the figure.
Applies area = base × height ÷ 2.
States the exact area (an integer or a fraction in simplest form) in square units.

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School mensuration (area of triangles, base and perpendicular height)

subtopic: area of a composite rectilinear shape by decomposition
microSkill: find the area of a composite rectilinear shape by decomposing into rectangles
objectiveWording: Find the area of a composite rectilinear shape by decomposing it into rectangles (adding the parts, or subtracting a missing rectangle from a bounding rectangle), giving the answer as an exact area in square units of the stated unit.
successCriteria: Decomposes the shape into non-overlapping rectangles (by addition or by subtraction from a bounding rectangle).
Finds each rectangle's area and combines them correctly.
States the exact total area in square units of the stated unit.

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School mensuration (area of composite rectilinear shapes by decomposition)

subtopic: missing length from a given perimeter
microSkill: find a missing side length of a rectangle given its perimeter
objectiveWording: Find a missing side length of a rectangle given its perimeter and the other side, giving the answer as an exact length in the stated unit.

crossDomainRelationships.relationship: applies one-step inverse reasoning to recover the unknown side

successCriteria: Uses the fact that the side lengths sum to the perimeter.
Subtracts the known sides to recover the missing length (a one-step inverse).
States the exact missing length with the correct unit.

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School mensuration (missing length from a given perimeter)

subtopic: missing rectangle dimension from a given area
microSkill: find a missing rectangle dimension given its area
objectiveWording: Find a missing dimension of a rectangle given its area and the other dimension, giving the answer as an exact length in the stated unit.

crossDomainRelationships.relationship: applies one-step multiplicative inverse reasoning to recover the unknown dimension

successCriteria: Uses the fact that area = length × width.
Divides the area by the known dimension to recover the missing one (a one-step inverse).
States the exact missing length with the correct unit.

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School mensuration (missing rectangle dimension from a given area)

subtopic: missing triangle base or height from a given area
microSkill: find a missing triangle base or perpendicular height given its area
objectiveWording: Find a missing base or perpendicular height of a triangle given its area and the other measurement, giving the answer as an exact length in the stated unit (only when the answer is exact).

crossDomainRelationships.relationship: applies one-step multiplicative inverse reasoning to recover the unknown base or height

successCriteria: Uses the fact that area = base × height ÷ 2.
Rearranges to recover the missing base or perpendicular height (a one-step inverse on 2 × area).
States the exact missing length with the correct unit.

sourceReferences.locator: Middle School mensuration (missing triangle base or height from a given area)
